title: CSAT (Paper II) - Practice Test 1
description: Practice test for CSAT focusing on Comprehension, Logical Reasoning, and Quantitative Aptitude.

questions.text: If A is the brother of B; B is the sister of C; and C is the father of D, how D is related to A?
questions.explanation: A is male (brother). B is female (sister). C is male (father of D). A is B's brother, so A is C's brother. D is C's child. So D is A's Nephew or Niece.

questions.text: Find the missing number in the series: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
questions.explanation: Differences are 4, 6, 8, 10. Next difference should be 12. 30 + 12 = 42.
